items.source: identifier - the ID of the object that should have been retrieved
items.translation: identifier - 本应检索到的对象的 ID

items.source:
Create a new ObjectRetrievalFailureException for the given object,
with the given explicit message and exception.
items.translation: 为给定的对象、明确的消息和异常创建一个新的 ObjectRetrievalFailureException。

items.source:
Create a new ObjectRetrievalFailureException for the given object,
with the default "not found" message.
items.translation: 为给定的对象创建一个带有默认“未找到”消息的 ObjectRetrievalFailureException。

items.source:
Exception thrown if a mapped object could not be retrieved via its identifier.
Provides information about the persistent class and the identifier.
items.translation: 如果无法通过标识符检索映射对象，则抛出异常。提供有关持久化类和标识符的信息。

items.source:
Create a general ObjectRetrievalFailureException with the given message,
without any information on the affected object.
items.translation: 创建一个通用的 `ObjectRetrievalFailureException`，并附带给定的消息，但不包含有关受影响对象的信息。

items.source: Return the identifier of the object that was not found.
items.translation: 返回未找到对象的标识符。

items.source:
Return the persistent class of the object that was not found.
If no Class was specified, this method returns null.
items.translation: 返回未找到对象的持久化类。如果未指定任何类，此方法返回 null。

items.source:
Return the name of the persistent class of the object that was not found.
Will work for both Class objects and String names.
items.translation:
返回未找到对象的持久化类的名称。  
该操作对 Class 对象和字符串名称均有效。

items.source: persistentClassName - the name of the persistent class
Return the persistent class of the object that was not found.
items.translation: 返回未找到对象的持久化类。

items.source: Return the name of the persistent class of the object that was not found.
items.translation: 返回未找到对象的持久化类的名称。
